items.title: Explore WoW: Forever with a Gamepad
items.summary: Explore WoW: Forever with a Gamepad Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) A spell to cast, an ally to heal, a well-earned reward to collect—there’s plenty to keep you busy in Azeroth. If you prefer a gamepad, World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another way to join the action. In World of Warcraft: Forever, we’ve refined targeting, casting, looting, and menu navigation for gamepads while keeping the familiar feel players have come to know. Get to Know Your Gamepad Experience WoW: Forever supports all XInput-compatible controllers and includes Xbox and PlayStation button icons to help you recognize the controls. Switch to Gamepad Controls Press Escape to open the Game Menu , select Options , then choose Gamepad under Gameplay to switch from keyboard-and-mouse input. Make the experience your own in the Gamepad settings. You can adjust Camera , HUD Modifier , Frame Focus Style , Action Bars , Targeting , and Raid Targeting Options . Just as you arrange spells and abilities on your action bars, take a little time to set up your gamepad controls around the abilities you use. Try a layout that feels comfortable, then adjust it as you learn new spells or change how you play. A little faction pride, right in your hands! items.title: What's New and What Feels Familiar in WoW: Forever
items.summary: What's New and What Feels Familiar in WoW: Forever Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) From a well-fought battle to a look that feels uniquely yours, the moments that matter in WoW are personal. World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another setting for those interests, whether you play the modern game, prefer Classic, haven’t logged in for a while, or are getting to know Warcraft for the first time. If you play the modern game, some elements will feel familiar, while others take a different approach. Here’s a look at the controls, content, and character choices that can help you decide what you’d like to try. Controls and Conveniences Experience Presets bundle the game’s initial visual and interface settings into two options: Classic and Enhanced. The choice affects presentation, not which Ruleset you play on. Individual settings remain adjustable in Game Menu > Options. Enhanced puts several conveniences within easy reach for players accustomed to modern WoW: Quest guidance: Points of interest and marked objective areas help you find where to go next. One-bag view: See your inventory together rather than opening each bag separately. Transmog: Keep character appearance part of your adventure. Movement and layout: Start with keyboard bindings for strafing and a centralized screen layout. Character visuals: Begin with high-definition character models.

items.title: WoW: Forever Development Notes - November 2
items.summary: WoW: Forever Development Notes - November 2 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Since the last full update to the Beta on October 15, we’ve continued to work to solve issues, refine classes, improve gameplay in all areas, and address feedback we received from Beta testers. What follows are the updates and changes that have been developed over those last 2.5 weeks. We’ve included the previously-posted updates to racial talents and abilities for completeness here. And once again, thank you so much to everyone who tested the Beta with us and provided so much feedback. Your efforts are greatly appreciated, and we can’t wait to see you on November 4! Bug Fixes Throw will now correctly use the 0.5 second windup timer (was incorrectly using the throwing weapon’s attack speed). Legacy Reward - Replica Ironforge Air Rifle can now correctly be used on allies that also have one equipped. Duration of the quitter debuff reduced to 40 seconds (was 5 minutes). Duration of the stun reduced to 2.5 seconds (was 3 seconds). All Races now have the correct amount of base stats. For example, Tauren Warriors now start with the correct +5 strength relative to Human Warriors (was incorrectly +2). This fix was also applied to High Order and Windshaper Skyborne base stats. Roots that occur from Procs now correctly have Diminishing Returns. Includes Frostbite, Entrapment, Impr
